scope: Human-visible pixel inspection of actual browser captures, independent of CPU assertions

visualFindings.deep: The giant near-camera canopy that covered the upper-left view is removed from the endpoint line of sight; open water and fish schools are visible.
visualFindings.deepReverse: The near tall reef is moved aside; a central sand passage and smaller coral foreground can be seen.
visualFindings.mid: New low coral outcrops, curved fan coral, and higher fish schools occupy different depth and height layers.
visualFindings.style: Original palette and sculpted reef language retained; only the existing two arches remain.
visualFindings.mobileMenu: Menu occupies upper part of 390x740 view and stays above touch swimming and bottom tour controls.

limitations: Some return headings are relatively sparse.
Physical phone performance and real multitouch are not tested.
